about: Test cases (the testCases item: the case and its file's imports) for testOracle, 65 in all: 12 tautological and 53 independent. Real cases come from this repo's test files: 3 tautological ones at the revision before their fix (the ask round trip that guidedask review-1 m4 named, at 9fa41da1e; the encoder config and lookbook head that 02a9e565b replaced with literal oracles), and every independent one, among them those fixes' literal versions and near misses that call the function under test on both sides over different inputs, read a helper on the expected side beside a literal, or compare against another implementation. Reviewed tautologies whose oracle sits outside the case (hymnal chord.test.ts's spell oracle, catalogue.test.ts's renderState matrix, edits-kept.ts, a non-test file) are left out, since the item cannot show them; the 9 hand cases (all tautological) fill that gap in the shapes the reviews named: a self-comparison, a want recomputed by the function, a fake answering with the function under test, an old record made by today's encoder, an expected value copied from the actual, a golden written in the case. The last 18 independent cases are every open finding of the lint that an Opus-max reviewer judged false (2026-10-19, judged-efficiency): property checks (determinism, purity, round-trip and metamorphic), whose oracle is the code under test called again by design; each at 9738c971a with the reviewer's reason as its why.

cases.label: tautological

cases.label: independent
cases.why: talkCut (via cutOf) is checked for purity, with talkCut over the original inputs as the oracle, so hidden state or identity dependence in talkCut fails it ('cuts equal edits over equal transcripts to equal plays').

cases.label: independent
cases.why: matchRun over one PhraseAutomaton runs twice to check statelessness, and an automaton that 'held match state' would make the second run differ, so the defect the case names fails it.

cases.label: independent
cases.why: The WikiPage codec round trip starts from a written-out fixture (page(LINEUP)) and checks that decode(encode(decoded)) equals decoded, so an encode that decode does not invert fails it.

cases.label: independent
cases.why: vectorizeFilter is checked metamorphically ('excluding apparatus narrows nothing more'), its default output is pinned by a literal in the first case, and a clause added for excludeApparatus would fail it.

cases.label: independent
cases.why: The TimingsJson codec round trip runs over a take fixture written out in full, a decode that refuses or changes the encoded text (for example the source transformation) fails it, and literal-text cases beside it pin the file format.

cases.label: independent
cases.why: compile's sourceDigest is checked for determinism, the complement of the 'changes when' cases beside it, so a digest that varies between runs over equal input fails it.

cases.label: independent
cases.why: The drift camera (camera inside hearingCameras, via the inside helper) is checked to be 'pure in the scene time', so drift read from wall time or accumulated state would make the two frames differ.

cases.label: independent
cases.why: The function under test is syncAnswer's no-stored-page fallback, not reportPage (its own case pins reportPage by literals), so a route that skips the Markdown or renders the wrong report fails it.

cases.label: independent
cases.why: mergeProps is checked to return the same handler object across reads (toBe), so a view that builds a fresh merged handler per read, without its handler cache, fails it.

cases.label: independent
cases.why: A toWorkspaceString then parseWorkspace round trip from a literal link, so a writer that drops a key such as noref or section2 fails it, and literal cases pin the parse.

cases.label: independent
cases.why: rng is checked for seeded determinism, a different sequence from another seed, and the [0, 1) range, so an unseeded or seed-blind rng fails it.

cases.label: independent
cases.why: renderVerseSegments is held to its documented equivalence with segmentVerseText, a public function pinned by literal cases, so a default phrase layer or mis-defaulted margin notes would break it, though both share composeSegments.

cases.label: independent
cases.why: Place.decode and Place.href for each page place are round-tripped over the written-out LINKS fixture, whose hrefs the case before pins, so an href that decodes to another value fails it.

cases.label: independent
cases.why: litNow is asked again at 1.5 s after a read at 0.2 s to check that it 'lights the same ranges, whatever came before it', so a litNow that keeps history fails it.

cases.label: independent
cases.why: measureSheet (via read) is checked metamorphically, a sheet with transparent paper must box like the opaque one and keep a literal empty flag list, so reading clear pixels as ink fails it.

cases.label: independent
cases.why: The boardChanges and changeOf id is checked stable for one try and different for a try made at another time, so an id keyed on the try number alone fails the not.toEqual.

cases.label: independent
cases.why: encodeVectorIndex (via build) is checked to be 'byte-identical across two builds of the same rows', so any nondeterminism in the writer fails it.

cases.label: independent
cases.why: acted is checked to clamp a beat past its end (progress 1.5 must equal progress 1), so without the clamp in toward the lerp overshoots and the test fails.
